items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: I never heard of her. No, I knew she did. She's dead. She's a great piano.

ctx.x: All right, she read it. She plays jazz and jazz.

Jazz. I said there was a jazz piano player that had right here in relation to me. What's her name? Nellie Reese? You know Nellie Reese? Hicks? Yeah. Nellie Reese. She's dead, though. Yeah, she was a great piano player, Nellie Reese. I never heard of her. No, I knew she did. She's dead. She's a great piano. Who teaches you two? Excuse me. All the sisters are almost at all school teachers. What did R.D. play in everything?
